name: ROAD-GAPS-through-a-path
why: A path pixel on the straight way within LINK_GAP is a nearer candidate itself: another piece's is linked to first (nearest first), and the source's own piece's - a bend of its own road nearer the target - links from there when its turn in reading order comes. The pieces end the same; the check keeps a link from being laid across the source's own road, a second band of bits through it.
